name: IntegrateIT Lutron HomeWorks QS
notes: Telnet (LIP) integration with a Lutron HomeWorks QS processor: prompt-based login, control and live monitoring of up to 8 mapped integration IDs — dimmer level set with fade, raise / lower / stop for Sivoia QS shades — with per-zone level variables, level-change events, and reconnect with exponential backoff. MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
